condition: Many streets in the north district of Northfold have no working lights after dark.
affected: Evening commuters and older residents, size unknown, who avoid the streets after dark.

observed_facts.statement: The council report lists 41 street lights out in the north district.

uncertain_claims.statement: Most outages may follow one shared fault.
uncertain_claims.why_uncertain: No repair log links the outages.
uncertain_claims.what_would_settle_it: The lighting department repair log for the district.

sources.establishes: The count of lights out in the district.

causal_hypothesis.statement: Repairs may be slow because one fault line feeds many lights (hypothesis).

scope: Street lighting in the north district since last March, not other utilities.
desired_outcome: Every street in the district is lit at night and anyone can check the repair log.

final_acceptance_criteria.statement: Fewer than 5 lights out in the district.
final_acceptance_criteria.how_observed: The public repair log, read at the end of the period.

assumptions.statement: The repair budget is not the limit.

stage_plan.name: map_outages
stage_plan.label: Map the outages
stage_plan.goal: List every street where the lights are out.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Every street with lights out is listed.
acceptance_criteria.measure: A public list checked against the council report.

stage_plan.name: map_outages
stage_plan.label: Ask for the repair schedule
stage_plan.goal: Get the repair schedule from the lighting department.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The department has published its repair schedule.
acceptance_criteria.measure: The schedule is posted on the council site.

stage_plan.name: agree_plan
stage_plan.label: Agree a repair plan
stage_plan.goal: Settle which streets are repaired first.

acceptance_criteria.measure: The vote result is recorded with the order of streets.
